Name: etf_target_duplicate_keys_corrected
SQL: SELECT count() AS duplicate_keys FROM (SELECT ts_code,ann_date,end_date,symbol,count() AS key_rows FROM etf_portfolio WHERE ts_code IN ('512770.SH','589330.SH') AND ann_date>='2026-01-01' AND ann_date<'2026-10-01' GROUP BY ts_code,ann_date,end_date,symbol) WHERE key_rows>1
